top_signals.title: Seoul Needs a Playbook for Hormuz, Ukraine, and What Comes Next
top_signals.summary:
Earlier this month, President Donald Trump shared a Washington Post opinion piece on his social media, arguing that South Korea should send its Cheongung-II air-defense system to Ukraine. Additionally, the Trump administration continues to pressure Seoul to send troops to the Strait of Hormuz. Neither the U.S.-Iranian conflict nor the Russo-Ukrainian War is new, yet the simultaneity of U.S. pressure on Seoul to help in its war with Iran and to support Ukraine is striking.While such diverging asks are indeed unprecedented, this is partly due to a lack of principles that stipulate a clear South Korean position. top_signals.title: European Union Needs to Reduce Dependency on China, Says Spain's Prime Minister
top_signals.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez said that the European Union needs to reduce its dependency on China and rebalance its dependence on other economies.  Sanchez, who sat down with Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua, said that one of the EU's strengths its is willingness to open its economies to other regions.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: No evidence of successful foreign meddling in 2024 election, spy agencies found
